claim_being_audited: The Actor claims the model should be certified now, based on aggregate readiness passing and no severity-one rehearsal incidents, on the theory that the remaining clinical-trial intake weakness can be handled through disclosure and completion of mitigation details.
decision_criteria: If admissible evidence showed the slice-level weakness was resolved, certification support would strengthen materially.
If admissible evidence showed an approved mitigation/risk-acceptance record with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion, certification with explicit disclosure could be supportable.
If the model-card and launch packet were updated to accurately disclose the limitation, the current policy gap would narrow.
Absent one of those conditions, aggregate readiness and clean rehearsal results are not enough to satisfy the stated policy threshold for this certification claim.
evidence_requests: Provide an approved mitigation or risk-acceptance record covering this launch use case, with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.
Provide the updated model-card language explicitly disclosing the clinical-trial intake limitation, or evidence showing the issue is resolved or not material for the named launch use case.
Provide the approval artifact tying the mitigation to launch authorization under the stated release policy.
specific_concerns: The record contains an unresolved slice-level weakness in a named launch use case: clinical-trial intake, concentrated in protocol eligibility support.
The mitigation runbook is still draft and lacks at least a defined alert threshold and accountable owner; no approval is in evidence.
The model-card draft currently states there are no known material limitations, which conflicts with evidence of a remaining issue and a reviewer prompt to disclose it.
Policy requires disclosure of material limitations unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch; that predicate is unresolved in the packet.
Public governance guidance supports documentation and monitoring, but it does not satisfy the internal policy conditions for certification support on its own.
unsupported_claims: The present record does not support certifying the model now without first showing either that the weakness is not material, that it has been resolved, or that an approved mitigation/risk acceptance meeting policy elements exists.
The packet does not support any implication that draft monitoring controls alone eliminate the current disclosure obligation.
The packet does not support the current model-card statement that there are no known material limitations.
